items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-11-10
items.q: I'm reading Buddy Stahl's book on New Orleans.

ctx.x: You know why they call them shotgun houses? Do you know? I've always assumed because of the... the barrel effect. No, you can say at the front door with a shotgun it shoots right through to the back door. There's nothing in between. There's a door all the way going... going all the way back. And that's what... What they call the shotgun... But they've got different names by now. They're finding out more people... That wasn't nothing... A bunch of thieves and they're glorifying them. It's a funny thing how history…
How did it come to be called craps? Yeah. How did it come to be called craps?
